patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Outreach and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than ZoomInfo's shape. Choose ZoomInfo only if your buying job matches “Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, in” rather than Outreach's shape. Workflow advantage: Outreach leans sales-engagement; ZoomInfo leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Outreach and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits).; ZoomInfo is Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, intent, and Copilot workflows — custom-quote packagi.
- Workflow coverage skew: Outreach-leaning sales-engagement vs ZoomInfo-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; ZoomInfo — Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only; ZoomInfo: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Credit consumption on export (CSV/CRM/API) requires ongoing governance.

Poor-fit cases: Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · ZoomInfo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Outreach if you actually need ZoomInfo's motion (Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enri)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
